research_mode: official Building Safety Regulator and GOV.UK primary guidance only; higher-risk building control approval, application information, controlled changes and completion-certificate methodology gates; no parcel result or safety score claimed

sources.name: Completion-certificate trigger
verified_claims: A completion certificate application is required when higher-risk building work is completed.
limitations: Completion claimed by the applicant is subject to BSR assessment and inspection.

sources.name: Completion certificate and registration
verified_claims: A completion certificate is needed to register a higher-risk residential building before occupation.
limitations: A certificate does not replace registration or occupation-phase duties.

sources.name: Full completion certificate
verified_claims: A full certificate is used after completing a new higher-risk building project or work to an existing higher-risk building.
limitations: The certificate scope must match the approved project.

sources.name: Partial completion eligibility
verified_claims: A partial certificate is available only where an approved partial-completion strategy was submitted and the application follows it.
limitations: Partial completion cannot be improvised outside the approved strategy.

sources.name: Changing partial-completion strategy
verified_claims: Changes to a partial-completion strategy must be submitted through the change-control process.
limitations: Submission does not establish that the revised strategy is approved.

sources.name: Completion application access
verified_claims: The online service requires the approval reference and access to the original application email address.
limitations: Service access does not establish authority to make substantive declarations.

sources.name: Completed-work summary
verified_claims: The application provides a summary of covered work and its completion date.
limitations: A stated completion date is not independent evidence of completion.

sources.name: Latest agreed documents
verified_claims: Applications upload current drawings, construction and change-control plans, MOR plan, compliance statement and relevant fire documents.
limitations: Latest-labelled files may still be incomplete or inconsistent.

sources.name: Additional completion documents
verified_claims: Applications may require the partial-completion strategy, drain and sewer plans and drainage precautions.
limitations: Document applicability depends on project scope.

sources.name: Dutyholder compliance declarations
verified_claims: Principal designers and principal contractors sign declarations confirming fulfilment of building-regulation duties.
limitations: Signed declarations do not replace BSR's assessment or inspection.

sources.name: Client confirmation statement
verified_claims: The client signs a statement that, to the best of their knowledge, the work meets relevant building regulations.
limitations: The statement is qualified by the client's knowledge and is not conclusive proof.

sources.name: Completion change log
verified_claims: The change-control log is submitted with the completion-certificate application.
limitations: A complete-looking log does not prove every site change was recorded.

sources.name: Building-information handover
verified_claims: The client confirms handover to the responsible person or relevant accountable person, with applicable signatures.
limitations: Handover confirmation does not prove information quality or recipient verification.

sources.name: BSR completion assessment
verified_claims: BSR compares application documents and changes and inspects completed work before deciding.
limitations: Inspection scope and findings are project-specific.

sources.name: Completion decision and charges
verified_claims: Approval requires compliant work, complete accurate information and handover; rejection, review and appeal routes apply, and overdue charges can prevent issue.
limitations: A decision pathway or paid charge does not establish compliance.
